title: Linear Demand Systems are Consistent with Discrete Choice
abstract: arXiv:2610.13785v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aggregate linear demand systems can be micro-founded by a population of heterogeneous consumers making discrete choices. They can also be extended to incorporate income effects. I prove these results and show how to structurally estimate this class of models using only market-level data. The distribution of consumer preferences is recovered by disciplining the corner solutions with aggregate terms only. This approach allows for the same richness of Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes (1995) [BLP] while retaining the analytical and computational advantages of linear demand: it does not require exogenously fixing market size, allows for heterogeneity in choice sets, and results in a flexible substitution matrix which varies endogenously as different consumers enter/exit the market. The discrete-choice microfoundation facilitates welfare analysis and the flexible measurement of markups an cost pass-throughs, among a wide range of other applications

translated_title: 线性需求系统与离散选择相一致
translated_abstract: 加总线性需求系统可以由一群进行离散选择的异质性消费者提供微观基础。它们还可以被扩展以纳入收入效应。我证明了这些结果，并展示了如何仅使用市场层面数据对这类模型进行结构估计。消费者偏好分布的恢复仅通过用加总项来约束角点解即可实现。这一方法能够达到与Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes (1995) [BLP]同等的丰富性，同时保留线性需求在分析和计算上的优势：它不需要外生固定市场规模，允许选择集存在异质性，并且产生一个灵活的替代矩阵，该矩阵会随着不同消费者进入或退出市场而内生变化。离散选择微观基础便于进行福利分析以及加成率和成本转嫁的灵活测量，并支持其他广泛的应用。
tldr: 本文证明加总线性需求系统可由异质性消费者的离散选择行为提供微观基础，并提出一种仅需市场层面数据的结构估计方法，兼具BLP模型的丰富性与线性需求的分析和计算优势。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that aggregate linear demand systems can be micro-founded by heterogeneous consumers making discrete choices, and proposes a structural estimation method using only market-level data, combining the richness of BLP with the analytical and computational advantages of linear demand.
